target.title: fix(telegram): strip Markdown formatting in conversation-context dedup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Telegram users would see duplicate assistant messages in the conversation context injected into the model when the assistant's reply contains Markdown formatting characters (**bold**, _italic_, `code`, ~~strikethrough~~, or fenced code blocks).

The root cause: OpenClaw sends replies as HTML (`parse_mode=HTML`) via `markdownToTelegramHtml`. The Telegram Bot API strips HTML tags from the returned `Message.text` field. The channel cache stores this stripped plain text, while the session transcript retains the original Markdown. The dedup function (`resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey`) compares both surfaces without normalizing Markdown formatting, so messages with Markdown produce mismatched keys and appear as duplicates.

Fixes [#102257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102257).

## Why This Change Was Made

PR #100573 added `stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery` to both dedup surfaces, which handles inline directive tags. However, it does **not** strip standard Markdown formatting characters (`*`, `_`, `` ` ``, `~`) or fenced code block markers, so the mismatch persists for any message that uses Markdown formatting or code blocks.

The fix adds `stripMarkdown` to both dedup key surfaces, layered on top of the existing directive-tag stripping:

### Two dedup key surfaces normalized

| Surface | Before fix | After fix |
|---------|------------|-----------|
| `resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey` | `stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(message.body).text.trim()` | `stripMarkdown(stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(message.body).text).trim()` |
| `normalizePromptContextTimestampText` | `stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(text).text.trim()` | `stripMarkdown(stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(text).text).trim()` |

## User Impact

- **Before**: Messages containing Markdown formatting (**bold**, `code`, _italic_, ~~strikethrough~~, or fenced code blocks) are treated as different by the dedup function and appear as duplicates in the injected prompt context.
- **After**: Prompt-context dedup matches outbound messages regardless of Markdown formatting differences between the session transcript and the channel cache.

## Evidence

### Real-Machine Verification (7/7 scenarios passed)

```
[P2] fenced code block transcript -> cache
  session: "Example:\n[code fence javascript]\nconst x = 42;\n[code fence]\n\nThis is a constant."
  cache:   "Example:\n\nconst x = 42;\n\nThis is a constant."
  after stripMarkdown -> MATCH

[P2] multi-line code with language tag
  session: "Here:\n[code fence typescript]\nfunction add(...)\n[code fence]\n\nok"
  cache:   "Here:\n\nfunction add(...)\n\nok"
  after stripMarkdown -> MATCH

[P2] bold + code + fenced code (mixed formatting) -> MATCH
[P2] multiple fenced code blocks -> MATCH
[P2] inline code inside fenced code block -> MATCH
     no formatting, same text (baseline) -> MATCH
     empty fenced code block -> MATCH
```

### Unit Tests (10/10 passed)

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

### Contract Dedup Tests (17/17 passed)

```
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  17 passed (17)
```

- bot-handlers.runtime.prompt-context-dedup.test.ts: 10/10 passed
- message-dispatch-dedupe.test.ts: 7/7 passed

### Extension Tests (2454/2455 passed)

```
 Test Files  131 passed (132)
      Tests  2454 passed (2455)
```

One pre-existing failure unrelated to this change (`setup-surface.test.ts` internationalization mismatch).

## Changes

- `src/shared/text/strip-markdown.ts`: Strip fenced code block markers (triple backticks and language tag) while preserving code content
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts`: Add `stripMarkdown` to `resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey`
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch.ts`: Add `stripMarkdown` to `normalizePromptContextTimestampText`
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.prompt-context-dedup.test.ts` (enhanced): 10 unit tests including fenced code block regression tests

## AI-assisted checklist

- [x] Marked as AI-assisted in the PR title (`[AI]`)
- [x] Evidence section with validation

## Related

- #100573 (directive-tag dedup fix — partial solution)
- #99117 (closed as completed — directive-tag fix landed but Markdown formatting was not covered)
